traits.name: Inspired Courage
traits.desc: The mercenary has advantage on savings throws against being charmed, frightened, grappled, or restrained while within 5 feet of at least one ally.

traits.name: Martial Advantage
traits.desc: Once per turn, the mercenary can deal an extra 7 (2d6) damage to a creature it hits with a weapon attack if that creature is within 5 feet of an ally of the mercenary that isn't incapacitated.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The mercenary makes two longsword attacks.

actions.name: Longsword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) slashing damage.

actions.name: Heavy Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 100/400 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) piercing damage.

sb.name: Tyreus, Illusionist
sb.damage_resistances: damage from spells; nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, slashing (from stoneskin)
sb.languages: Common, Deep Speech, Draconic, Primordial, Sylvan

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.desc: If Tyreus fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Illusory Reality
traits.desc: When Tyreus casts an illusion spell of 1st level or higher, he can choose one inanimate, nonmagical object that is part of the illusion and make that object real. He can do this on his turn as a bonus action while the spell is ongoing. The object remains real for 1 minute. The object can't deal damage or otherwise directly harm anyone.

traits.name: Displacement (Recharges after Tyreus Casts an Illusion Spell of 1st Level or Higher)
traits.desc: As a bonus action, Tyreus projects an illusion that makes him appear to be standing a few inches from his actual location, causing any creature to have disadvantage on attack rolls against Tyreus. The effect ends if Tyreus takes damage, he is incapacitated, or his speed becomes 0.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.desc:
Tyreus is a 16th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 18, +10 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared.

- **Cantrips (at will):** [[Tools/Spells/Fire Bolt|fire bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Light|light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|mage hand]], [[Tools/Spells/Minor Illusion|minor illusion]], [[Tools/Spells/Shocking Grasp|shocking grasp]]
- **1st level (4 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|mage armor]], [[Tools/Spells/Magic Missile|magic missile]], [[Tools/Spells/Shield|shield]], [[Tools/Spells/Thunderwave|thunderwave]]
- **2nd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Invisibility|invisibility]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Mirror Image|mirror image]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Phantasmal Force|phantasmal force]]*
- **3rd level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Counterspell|counterspell]], [[Tools/Spells/Fly|fly]], [[Tools/Spells/Lightning Bolt|lightning bolt]], [[Tools/Spells/Major Image|major image]]*
- **4th level (3 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Banishment|banishment]], [[Tools/Spells/Hallucinatory Terrain|hallucinatory terrain]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Phantasmal Killer|phantasmal killer]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Stoneskin|stoneskin]]
- **5th level (2 slots):** [[Tools/Spells/Conjure Elemental|conjure elemental]], [[Tools/Spells/Mislead|mislead]]*, [[Tools/Spells/Telekinesis|telekinesis]]
- **6th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Disintegrate|disintegrate]]
- **7th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Plane Shift|plane shift]]
- **8th level (1 slot):** [[Tools/Spells/Maze|maze]]

*(Illusion spell of 1st level or higher)

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +8 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Modify Illusion
actions.desc: When Tyreus casts an illusion spell that has a duration of 1 minute or longer, he can use his action to change the nature of that illusion (using the spell's normal parameters for the illusion), provided that he can see the illusion.

legendary_actions.name: Scrutinize
legendary_actions.desc: Tyreus makes an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check.

legendary_actions.name: Cast Cantrip
legendary_actions.desc: Tyreus casts a cantrip from his spell list.

legendary_actions.name: Cast Spell (Costs 1-3 Actions)
legendary_actions.desc: Tyreus uses a spell slot to cast a 1st-, 2nd-, or 3rd-level spell that he has prepared. Doing so costs 1 legendary action per level of the spell.

sb.legendary_description: Legendary action uses: 3. One can be taken immediately after another creature's turn, and all uses come back at the start of this creature's turn.
